doc.brief: The QSpinBox class provides a spin box widget.

QString prefix() const.brief: This property holds the spin box's prefix

QString suffix() const.brief: This property holds the suffix of the spin box

QString textFromValue(int value) const.brief: This virtual function is used by the spin box whenever it needs to display the given *value*.

int displayIntegerBase() const.brief: This property holds the base used to display the value of the spin box

int maximum() const.brief: This property holds the maximum value of the spin box

int value() const.brief: This property holds the value of the spin box

int valueFromText(const QString &text) c.brief: This virtual function is used by the spin box whenever it needs to interpret *text* entered by the user as a value.

void setDisplayIntegerBase(int base).brief: This property holds the base used to display the value of the spin box

void setMaximum(int max).brief: This property holds the maximum value of the spin box

void setMinimum(int min).brief: This property holds the minimum value of the spin box

void setPrefix(const QString &prefix).brief: This property holds the spin box's prefix

void setRange(int minimum, int maximum).brief: Convenience function to set the *minimum*, and *maximum* values with a single function call.

void setSingleStep(int val).brief: This property holds the step value

void setSuffix(const QString &suffix).brief: This property holds the suffix of the spin box

void textChanged(const QString &text).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the spin box's text is changed.

void valueChanged(int i).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the spin box's value is changed.
